scenes.caption: Bifrost Meter (unofficial) puts your Bifrost budget in the VS Code status bar.
Set your virtual key once. The input is masked and the key stays in the editor's secret storage.
Mock traffic goes through a real Bifrost gateway. After a refresh, the percentage goes up and the dollars left go down.
Hover for every limit: budget, tokens and requests, with reset times and a forecast of when it runs out.
Click for the details panel, including spend by model from the gateway.
Past 75%, the status bar turns to a warning colour and one notification appears.
At 100% the gateway refuses requests, and the meter shows the budget as used up.
A coding agent reads the same numbers through the MCP tool get_budget_status. Real session, replayed.
